actions.note: run-a-settings.json: A: Settings: UI language English, add ws://127.0.0.1:8796 under Shared worlds, save, test

actions.eval: (() => { const ta = [...document.querySelectorAll('textarea')].find(t => (t.closest('label')?.innerText ?? '').includes('World services') || (t.labels?.[0]?.innerText ?? '').includes('World services')); if (!ta) return 'no field'; ta.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); ta.focus(); return ta === document.activeElement })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Shared worlds'); return at < 0 ? 'no section' : t.slice(at, at + 900) })()

actions.note: run-a2-test.json: A2: the Shared worlds Test button (clickText 'Test' in part A hit another panel's Test first; this one is found under the Shared worlds heading and clicked through the DOM)

actions.eval: (() => { const field = [...document.querySelectorAll('textarea')].find(t => t.value.includes('ws://127.0.0.1:8796')); let box = field; while (box && ![...box.querySelectorAll('button')].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Test')) box = box.parentElement; const btn = [...box.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Test'); btn.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); btn.click(); return 'clicked the Shared worlds Test' })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('ws://127.0.0.1:8796\n'); return at < 0 ? 'no probe line' : t.slice(at, at + 400) })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Not tested yet'); return at < 0 ? null : t.slice(Math.max(0, at - 300), at + 40) })()

actions.note: run-b-newgame.json: B: Worlds -> New game -> Start on the built-in world; wait for Play

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const t0 = Date.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); if (s.screen === 'play' && s.activeInstance) return { ms: Date.now() - t0, screen: s.screen, instance: s.activeInstance.instanceId ?? s.activeInstance }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'timeout: ' + S.useSessionStore.getState().screen })()

actions.note: run-c-share.json: C: E opens the door at home; share the world on 127.0.0.1:8796; read the door

actions.eval: (() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); return l ? l.innerText.slice(0, 2500) : 'no door layer' })()

(async () => { const t0 = Date.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const t = l ? l.innerText : ''; if (/Recorded on a public chain/.test(t) && /Online/.test(t)) return { ms: Date.now() - t0 }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); return 'timeout: ' + (l ? l.innerText.slice(0, 1500) : 'no door') })()
(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); return l ? l.innerText.slice(0, 4000) : 'no door layer' })()

actions.note: run-d-record.json: D: the door's chain section: turn on Record beats (an owner's `chain` event, record: true)

actions.eval: (async () => { const t0 = Date.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const t = l ? l.innerText : ''; if (/Recording is now|now: Record beats|Record beats\./.test(t) || [...(l?.querySelectorAll('button') ?? [])].some(b => b.innerText.trim() === 'Record beats' && b.disabled)) return { ms: Date.now() - t0 }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'timeout' })()

(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const t = l.innerText; const at = t.indexOf('Recorded on a public chain'); return { chain: t.slice(at, t.indexOf('Continent', at)), buttons: [...l.querySelectorAll('button')].filter(b => ['Record beats', "Don't record", 'Check again'].includes(b.innerText.trim())).map(b => ({ text: b.innerText.trim(), disabled: b.disabled, pressed: b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') })) } })()
(() => { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const t = l.innerText; return t.slice(t.indexOf('Sharing'), t.indexOf('Who may come in')) })()
(() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-layer=door] *')].find(e => e.innerText?.trim() === 'Recorded on a public chain'); h?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); return !!h })()
